en.hero-title: Your Local Partner for a Thriving Borana
en.hero-subtitle: Empowering enterprises, cooperatives, and communities in South Oromia with bankable business solutions.
en.services-subtitle: Comprehensive solutions for sustainable business growth.
en.about-text1: Ashraqa Business Development Services (BDS) is a multi-disciplinary consulting firm based in Yabelo, South Oromia, Ethiopia. The name 'Ashraqa' means 'sunrise,' reflecting our mission to bring new light, opportunity, and resilience to the businesses and communities of the region.
en.about-text2: We provide end-to-end support—from business planning and financial management to market linkages and digital innovation—helping enterprises transform into sustainable, growing ventures.
en.why1-text: We understand Borana's culture, market dynamics, and unique challenges.
en.why2-text: Trusted by cooperatives, MSMEs, and development partners.
en.why3-text: Fluent in Afaan Oromo, Amharic, and English for seamless communication.
en.why4-text: Customized solutions that fit your specific needs and goals.
en.cta-subtitle: Book a free consultation with our experts today.

om.hero-title: Michuu Naannoo Keessan, Misooma Booranaa Tiif!
om.hero-subtitle: Daldala, kootii fi hawaasa Oromiyaa Kibbaa deeggartii daldala cimaa kennuun guddisuu.
om.about-text1: Ashraqa BDS dhaabbata gorsaa fi tajaajila misooma daldalaa Magaalaa Yaaballoo, Oromiyaa Kibbaatti argamu. Maqaan 'Ashraqa' jechuun 'baha aduu' jechuu yoo ta'u, ifa haaraa, carraa fi cimina daldala naannichaa agarsiisa.
om.about-text2: Nuyi karoora daldalaa, bulchiinsa maallaqaa, walqabsiisa gabaa fi teeknooloojii dijitaalaa dabalatee deeggarsa guutuu kennina.
om.why1-text: Aadaa, haala gabaa fi rakkoo Booranaa sirriitti beekna.
om.why2-text: Kootii, daldaltoota fi michoota misoomaatiin amanamaa.
om.why3-text: Afaan Oromoo, Amaariffaa fi Ingiliffaan hojjechuu dandeenya.
om.why4-text: Furmaata fedhii keessanii fi kaayyoo keessaniif mijatu.
om.cta-subtitle: Har'a ogeeyyii keenya waliin gorsa bilisaa qabachuu.
